acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Halo Cluster Edit Parameters” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.

acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M05: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Halo Cluster Edit Parameters”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.

invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.

Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
